name: optcg-duel-trailer
description: Remotion project for the optcgduel.app trailer

scripts.studio: npm run prerender && remotion studio src/index.ts
scripts.render: npm run prerender && remotion render src/index.ts Trailer16x9 ../out/trailer-16x9.mp4 --concurrency=3 --crf=16
scripts.render:9x16: npm run prerender && remotion render src/index.ts Trailer9x16 ../out/trailer-9x16.mp4 --concurrency=3 --crf=16
scripts.still: npm run prerender && remotion still src/index.ts Trailer16x9
scripts.render:ad15: npm run render:ad15-9x16 && npm run render:ad15-4x5
scripts.render:ad30: npm run render:ad30-9x16 && npm run render:ad30-4x5
scripts.render:ad15-9x16: npm run prerender && remotion render src/index.ts Ad15-9x16 ../out/ads/ad-15s-9x16.mp4 --concurrency=3 --crf=16
scripts.render:ad15-4x5: npm run prerender && remotion render src/index.ts Ad15-4x5 ../out/ads/ad-15s-4x5.mp4 --concurrency=3 --crf=16
scripts.render:ad30-9x16: npm run prerender && remotion render src/index.ts Ad30-9x16 ../out/ads/ad-30s-9x16.mp4 --concurrency=3 --crf=16
scripts.render:ad30-4x5: npm run prerender && remotion render src/index.ts Ad30-4x5 ../out/ads/ad-30s-4x5.mp4 --concurrency=3 --crf=16
scripts.render:ads: npm run render:ad15 && npm run render:ad30 && node scripts/render-infographics.mjs story
